description: Backyard patio & fence installation for outdoor living space. Front yard replaced with Micro clover.

This home located on West 31st required a complete front and back yard renovation due to existing sunken patio pavers and an over used lawn. Level Ground removed the existing pavers and lawn and recreated a modern back yard with a new patio and walkway to the lane and a useable outdoor living space for entertaining. Yearly seasonal planting and garden maintenance.

After the removal of an old underground oil tank which left the yard unusable, our client requested to salvage the red bricks and to widen the patio area under the wooden stairs. They also asked Level Ground to install a small area for the barbeque grill with a new walkway and reshape the garden bed.
Extended outdoor patio space.

This Kitsilano home owner required a front yard with curb appeal. To revamp, Level Ground first removed existing sod from the front and the boulevard, removed and relocated two maple trees which were too close to the house. A new walkway was installed leading from the front of the house to the back yard and additional new soil and rock boulders were artistically placed.

description: Level Ground’s design team met with our client who was interested in having her front yard redone in her small townhouse complex. A wood patio deck, an artificial grass patch, a raised vegetable garden and a low maintenance garden with a replacement tree were created to meet all her needs.

After realizing that sooner or later the front lawn would be decimated by Crows and Raccoons searching for Beetle larvae, our client wanted to turn the neglected front yard into an outdoor living space. For privacy we install 5 feet tall English Yew with low maintenance plants.We also installed a water fountain to drown out some of the street noise, thus creating the perfect space for outdoor entertainment day or night.

Our client requested to have a low maintenance planting along the boulevard that was dog friendly. Level Ground excavated the existing lawn, installed paving slabs with black basalt gravel, sections of plants and a small lawn area.

The new home owners wanted a simple clean design to compliment their newly built residence with minimal contemporary landscaping. Level Ground installed walkways, pavers, a patio, new lawn, and planted flowers, shrubs and hedges.
Level Ground renewed an existing walkway which prevented a trip hazard and created a safe environment for the residents and homeowner.

Level Ground created a liveable outdoor space for a young couple with a small child plus a dog. Details included a sitting area with fire pit, garden spotlights to showcase surrounding cedar hedges and a low maintenance garden bed.
Level Ground removed the existing root-damaged lawn and installed a vibrant new lawn.
Garden renovation. Patio sitting area with bench.

Renewed backyard to entertain friends and family including artificial putting green for golf enthusiasts.
